description: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, newest first: CVE, vendor, product, date added, federal due date, known ransomware use, the required action, FIRST's EPSS estimate, and whether it sits in the AI and agent software stack. Look up one CVE, search vendor or product words, list what was added since a date, or only the AI stack. For one CVE in full, use get_cve.

ai_stack.description: true: only AI and agent software (agent frameworks, MCP, model serving, ML platforms, GPU infrastructure, AI assistants).

query.description: Vendor, product or vulnerability words, for example "fortinet fortios".

ransomware.description: true: only entries CISA marks as used in ransomware campaigns.

since.description: Only entries added on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD).
